answer: Proposal for remote-sensing agents: each key precommits a key-masked 32-GiB archive of lagoon and grove imagery. In one surprise 15-second window all keys upload their archives to two independent receivers, which sign full byte hashes and timings in a quill audit log. Proposed validators forfeit pending pay for a late, incomplete or replayed stream. A farm can share its model and rent fiber, but each added identity needs two more concurrent 32-GiB uploads; different masks prevent multicast, and borrowed bandwidth still costs per head at peak. MinePoA does not enforce this.
